name: Pega-Pega: the game
author: Ana Paula Crippa, Maria Eduarda Polican
description: A two-player chase-and-shoot duel: follow your opponent around and fire as soon as you have them in your sights. Two gamepads needed. Arrows to move, X to shoot.

descriptions.en: A two-player chase-and-shoot duel: follow your opponent around and fire as soon as you have them in your sights. Two gamepads needed. Arrows to move, X to shoot.
descriptions.it: Un duello per due giocatori: insegui l'avversario e spara appena lo hai sotto tiro. Servono due joypad. Frecce per muoverti, X per sparare.
